artist.name: Dakta Dub
artist.bio: Dakta Dub is a Hyderabad selector and radio presenter who began DJing in 2004 in Budapest, where he hosted the show Indian Lights on Tilos Radio. Back in Hyderabad from 2008, he started Monkey Radio and the bass night Bass Sanskriti, and he hosted Dub Rituals on boxout.fm, a show of meditative dub, chillout and psychedelic ambient.

eras.sound: Meditative mix of chillout, dub and psychedelic ambient
